---
# No title, subtitle or author: Quarto only emits a title slide when one of
# those is set, and this deck deliberately opens straight onto blank paper.
#
# The source contains one empty page with a permanent id. In the browser,
# scribble-pages.js appends another uniquely numbered blank page only when the
# reader navigates forward from the end. Its ordered page IDs are browser-local
# and restored on reload, so blank pages survive and middle pages can be deleted
# without renumbering the pages around them.
#
# Ink is stored under the explicit ids, so pages keep their own annotations.
# Deck-wide settings (theme, dimensions and browser tools) live in _quarto.yml.
---
